solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, directions as headed); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Small hint gives you this answer without difficulty

parts.note: to imply something is to hint at it without saying it outright

explanation.surface: A setter boasts that one tiny clue is enough to hand you the solution without any struggle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gives you this answer' is a self-referential link: the pieces give the answer, which means the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something simply means doing it easily, a plain adverbial synonym.

clue.text: It's scary getting converted in this part of church

indicators.note: converted means changed in form, and suits a church setting

parts.note: taken as written, apostrophe ignored
taken as written

explanation.surface: A church room gives someone the creeps, perhaps enough to bring about a conversion.
explanation.definitionFit: A sacristy is the room in a church where vestments and sacred vessels are kept.

clue.text: Climb Everest, say

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a mountain, Everest being one example

explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as an order to scale the world's highest peak; the two parts are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for ascending and a noun for a mountain, as in Mount Everest.

clue.text: With good fortune, rising was victorious in Asian city

parts.note: luck is good fortune

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means read from the bottom up

parts.note: won means was victorious

explanation.surface: With luck on their side, an uprising succeeded in an Asian city.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface recalls the 1857 Indian Rebellion, in which this Indian city was besieged.
explanation.definitionFit: Lucknow is a major city in northern India, capital of Uttar Pradesh.

clue.text: Indication of text missing over page, on which one's reprimanded

indicators.note: the mark is spread over the page abbreviation, enclosing it

parts.note: a caret is the proofreader's mark showing where something should be inserted

explanation.surface: An editor spots a gap in the text on a page and someone gets told off for it.
explanation.walkthrough: To be 'on the carpet' is to be summoned for a telling-off.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'called on the carpet' means being scolded by a superior, so the floor covering is where a reprimand happens.

clue.text: New part transformed European city

indicators.note: the letters are changed into a new form

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A new district has remade a city in Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Antwerp is a port city in Belgium.

clue.text: Place organised at court for rich and powerful person

indicators.note: the letters are arranged into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A place is arranged at a royal court for a wealthy grandee.
explanation.definitionFit: A plutocrat is someone whose power comes from wealth.

clue.text: Cast was uneasy when resting

definitions.meaning: second meaning: moved restlessly in bed

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a theatre cast unsettled during a break; the clue splits into two meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb covers both throwing something and turning about restlessly while trying to sleep.

clue.text: Court case mostly involved military vehicle

indicators.note: the letters are tangled up, as if involved in a complicated knot

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: most of the word case is used, its final letter dropped

parts.note: taken as written before trimming

explanation.surface: A court case turns out to concern an army vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A scout car is a light armoured reconnaissance vehicle used by armies.

clue.text: Pub turned up little information on drink — that's a blow

indicators.note: in a down clue the word is read upwards, reversed

parts.note: a bar is a pub
a bit is the smallest unit of information in computing
punch is a mixed drink

explanation.surface: A pub reveals little about its drinks, which is a letdown.
explanation.definitionFit: A rabbit punch is a chop to the back of the neck, a type of blow.

clue.text: Confidence about sweetheart being extremely faithful

indicators.note: the word for confidence goes about, surrounding, the other piece

parts.note: trust is confidence placed in someone
the heart of the word sweet is its middle letter

explanation.surface: Trust in one's beloved shows the most loyal devotion.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of true, in its sense of loyal, means most faithful.

clue.text: Colour reused in elegant interior, just in time

indicators.note: the answer sits in the run of letters spanning these two words

parts.note: the letters straddle the end of elegant and the start of interior

explanation.surface: A decorator reuses a colour in a stylish room, finishing just before the deadline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reused' says the same trick works a second time: the answer also lurks in 'just in time', making a double hidden clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A tint is a shade or hue, a light variety of a colour.

clue.text: On reversing, sounded horn, say, warning ladies and others

indicators.note: the word On is turned round, as a car reversing

parts.note: blew is the past tense of blowing a horn
an omen is a sign warning of what is to come

explanation.surface: A driver backing up honks the horn to warn some ladies and other pedestrians.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' marks the horn as just one thing that is blown.
explanation.definitionFit: Ladies are titled women, and the wider group also includes duchesses, countesses and other aristocratic women.

clue.text: Announcement intended for spectators but not players, supposedly

definitions.text: Announcement intended for spectators but not players, supposedly

parts.words: Announcement intended for spectators but not players, supposedly
parts.note: reads like a stadium tannoy message, but in theatre the actors on stage pretend not to hear a loud aside meant for the audience

explanation.walkthrough: Spectators and players suggest sport; read theatrically they are the audience and the actors.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a theatrical convention: a loud aside delivered so the audience hears it while fellow actors pretend not to.

clue.text: Period of development, for instance, held up on-line construction?

indicators.note: in a down clue, held up means the letters are raised, read in reverse

parts.note: a station is a building on a railway line

explanation.surface: A project is delayed while something is being built online.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on-line' looks like the internet but means on a railway line.
explanation.definitionFit: Gestation is the time a baby grows in the womb, and by extension any period of development.

clue.text: Person who looks after kids with nannies

definitions.text: Person who looks after kids with nannies

parts.words: Person who looks after kids with nannies
parts.note: sounds like a childminder working alongside nannies, but kids and nannies are young and female goats

explanation.walkthrough: Kids and nannies point to childcare; both are also goats.
explanation.definitionFit: A goatherd tends a herd of goats, which includes kids and nanny goats.

clue.text: Illustrated story from his trip — car too noisy

indicators.note: the piece comes from within the words his trip

parts.note: the letters run across the end of his and the whole of trip
taken as written

indicators.note: a noise is something heard, so the word too is taken by its sound

parts.note: spoken, it gives the sound of the final syllable

explanation.surface: Someone tells of a holiday where the hire car was too loud.
explanation.walkthrough: The homophone is loose: the spoken word too stands for the syllable ending the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A strip cartoon is a short sequence of drawings telling a story, a comic strip.

clue.text: Admonish traveller going on journey without clear destination

parts.note: a rep is a travelling sales representative
to rove is to wander with no fixed goal

explanation.surface: A salesman sets off on an aimless trip and gets told off.
explanation.definitionFit: To reprove is to rebuke or scold, a synonym of admonish.

clue.text: Cause of ill feeling disrupting gallery

indicators.note: the letters of the word are thrown into disorder

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Something upsetting people is causing chaos in an art gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ill feeling' suggests resentment, but here it is literal physical illness.
explanation.definitionFit: An allergy is a reaction that makes a person feel physically unwell.

clue.text: Country hiding nothing in scheme tried after three failures?

indicators.note: the zero goes in the middle of the scheme

parts.note: after plans A, B and C have failed you move on to plan D

explanation.surface: A nation with nothing to hide puts a desperate fourth plan into action.
explanation.definitionFit: Poland is a country in central Europe.

clue.text: Personal letters redistributed about US city making power generator

indicators.note: the letters are shared out again in a new order

parts.note: taken as written
LA is Los Angeles

explanation.surface: Private correspondence is rerouted around an American city to make electricity.
explanation.definitionFit: A solar panel converts sunlight into electricity, so it generates power.

clue.text: Dock tail of poodle that's appealingly pretty

parts.note: to dock is to cut short, as with an animal's tail

indicators.note: the tail is the final letter of the word poodle

parts.note: the word whose final letter is taken

explanation.surface: Clipping a poodle's tail leaves it charmingly sweet.
explanation.definitionFit: Cute means attractive in an endearing way, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Capital in company affected by inflation?

indicators.note: the company abbreviation is filled out by the other piece inside it

parts.note: you inflate a tyre or balloon with air

explanation.surface: Money held in a firm is hit by rising prices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' and 'inflation' suggest economics; the capital is a city and the inflation is pumping in air.
explanation.definitionFit: Cairo is the capital city of Egypt.

clue.text: Cash is not endlessly collected in this!

definitions.text: Cash is not endlessly collected in this!

indicators.note: each word is taken without its end, so every final letter is removed

parts.note: taken as written before the cut
taken as written before the cut
taken as written before the cut

explanation.surface: A gambling house is where money, it seems, never stops being gathered.
explanation.walkthrough: Each word loses its last letter: CAS, I, NO. The whole clue is also the definition, since a gaming house collects cash without end.
explanation.definitionFit: A casino is a gambling venue where punters' money is taken in at the tables all night.

clue.text: Male backed older females taking leading roles

parts.note: he is the male pronoun

indicators.note: the word for older is backed up, reading in reverse

parts.note: senior means older

explanation.surface: A man supports older women who are cast as stars.
explanation.definitionFit: Heroines are the women who play or are the central characters in a story.

clue.text: Ultimately, road rage becomes menace

indicators.note: ultimately points to the last letter of the next word

parts.note: the word whose final letter is taken
anger is rage

explanation.surface: Road rage turns out to be a threat to everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Danger and menace both name a threat of harm.

clue.text: Pronounced why, in general, it's a less important way

indicators.note: the letter goes in the word for general

parts.note: broad means general, as in broad terms

indicators.note: the word why is taken by its sound, as a letter

parts.note: the word why sounds like the letter Y

explanation.surface: Someone explains why, in general terms, a route is minor.
explanation.definitionFit: A byroad is a side road, a minor route off a main one.
